caseName: Lancaster Security Investment Corp. v. Kessler
caseNameFull: LANCASTER SECURITY INVESTMENT CORP. v. KESSLER Et Al.
attorneys: Morris Lavine for appellant., Cilhert E. Harris for Kessler et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
